description: This PHP source file defines the class TemplateMultiEnum, which extends TemplateEnum to implement a multi-select enumeration field for a CRM system. The class includes methods for generating HTML and template variables for editing and displaying multi-select enumerations, as well as handling field definitions and save operations.

classes.name: TemplateMultiEnum
classes.description: A class representing a multi-select enumeration field type for dynamic form fields within a CRM system. It handles rendering, data preparation, and field definition for multi-enum fields.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Generates HTML for editing the multi-select enum field, including a hidden input and a multiple select box.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Prepares an array of template variables for rendering the edit view, including options and help text.

methods.name: prepSave
methods.description: Placeholder method for preparing the field value before saving.

methods.name: get_xtpl_list
methods.description: Returns the same as get_xtpl_detail for list views.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Prepares template variables for displaying the field value in detail views, including translated labels.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array, including handling default values and dependencies, and marking the field as multi-select.

methods.name: get_db_default
methods.description: Returns an empty string as the default database value for this field.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes and saves default and dependency values for the field.
